page.intro: The percentages you see here are <bold>historical frequency</bold>, not a promise of what will happen: they count how often something happened before, always alongside the number of matches used. That's not the same as a guaranteed probability. <link>More on how to read them →</link>

detail.probabilitiesNote: EV is never shown on its own: it always comes with a confidence and risk level.
detail.probabilitiesOnlyNote: There are no market odds for this competition, so no expected value is calculated and nothing is flagged as ‘Value’. With your own odds, ‘Your EV’ is still calculated.
